courseCorrections.BENBUSI112: Provides specific complementary financial-statement analysis,accountability,costing,budgeting,organisational control and investment appraisal using discounted cash flows. These support interpretation of company data andfinancial choices; they do not supply a quantitative-finance specialisation.
courseCorrections.BENBUSI211: Studies AI foundations/limitations and business,economic andsocietal implications through cases andcountry-level AIreadiness/workforce/regulation inquiry. This supplies specific economic/application context for data-science decisions,not technical machine learning.
courseCorrections.BENECON211: Develops short/medium/long-run macroeconomic models,expectations,open-economy dynamics andfiscal/monetary policy using algebra,graphs andindicators. This supplies macroeconomic interpretation rather than a dedicated trade-theory sequence.
courseCorrections.DISARIN211: Develops probabilistic inference,Bayesian networks,temporal models,decision theory,Markov decision processes,partial observability andbandits. This is actual mathematical decision-making under uncertainty; not a specialised logistics or stochastics course.
courseCorrections.DISARIN212: Develops propositional/predicate logic,sets,relations,proof,induction,recursion anddeterministic process/game reasoning. These mathematical foundations complement formal models andalgorithms; no full optimisation syllabus is inferred.
courseCorrections.DISARIN311: Studies heuristic/global/local search,first/second-order methods,population approaches,constraint satisfaction,linear programming anddiscrete optimisation with implementation/evaluation. Actual optimisation methods contribute directly; dedicated convex/nonlinear-programming course equivalence is not claimed.
courseCorrections.DISCOMP312: Develops algebraic andnumber-theoretic algorithms,matrix/Fourier methods,greedy/dynamic programming andnetwork flows. Experimental projects test exact computing/optimisation,performance andsensitivity. This provides concrete algorithmic optimisation,not a complete combinatorial-optimisation sequence.
courseCorrections.GOSPHIL212: Develops utilitarian,Kantian,virtue,contractarian andfeminist ethical theories,argument evaluation andindependent essays. These are specific complementary normative tools for responsible economic choices; no prescribed wealth/poverty or econometric-professional case is guaranteed.
courseCorrections.HCBPSYC211: Develops experimental design andmultivariable models for group comparisons,categorical outcomes andlatent constructs,including assumption checks andinterpretation using R/RCommander. These support empirical inference; their primary application is health/behaviour,not dedicated econometrics.
